grammar.summary: 本课学习表目的的不定式链与 take...for granted。

points.title: take sth. for granted 表想当然
points.explanation: We take it for granted that... it 形式宾语 + 真宾语后置。granted 过去分词形容词化。

examples.en: We take it for granted that standards differ.
examples.cn: 我们想当然地认为标准各不相同。

points.title: be out to do 表意在
points.explanation: bureaucrats are out to make trouble. be out to do = 旨在做某事。

examples.en: Farmers are out to protect their interests.
examples.cn: 农民意在保护自己的利益。
